rising.title: heygen-com/hyperframes
rising.what: An open-source video editor where you write HTML to build or edit videos, then render them to MP4 files.
rising.why: Interests people exploring AI-assisted video creation, since coding agents can drive the editing workflow.

rising.title: tt-a1i/archify
rising.what: A skill that turns ideas, plans or codebases into interactive architecture diagrams for coding agents.
rising.why: Useful for developers who want agents to generate visual diagrams of their designs.

rising.why: Relevant to readers tracking AI in education and how multi-agent systems are applied to teaching.

items.what: A research paper describing a payment foundation model, about 7B parameters, combining sequence, tabular and graph data for payment risk detection.
items.why: Shows how large foundation models are being applied to financial fraud and risk detection in production payment systems.

items.title: Embo-Harness: Towards Understanding Frontier-Model-as-Policy Harness
items.what: A study of how frontier multimodal models can act as robot controllers when given the right tool and visual interfaces.
items.why: Relevant to readers following whether general models can directly control robots in manipulation tasks.

items.title: Don't Sleep, Keep Watch: Proactive Perception for Computer-Use Agents
items.what: A research paper proposing NightWatch, a lightweight streaming watcher that keeps vision-language computer-use agents synchronized with changing screen interfaces.
items.why: Addresses latency and wasted time in AI agents that control computers, relevant to anyone following computer-use agents.

items.title: stablyai/orca
items.what: A desktop, mobile and remote app for running a fleet of coding bots on your own subscriptions.
items.why: Relevant to people who run several Claude Code or Codex agents at once and want one control surface.
